sources: docs/proposals/vrm-author-cli/parameters.md (Hair, outfits and accessories; Rig, expression, gaze, spring and first-person fields)

inputClasses: project with an applied recipe (export stub pack, factory avatar)

parameterRanges.out: path that does not exist unless replace
parameterRanges.threads: positive integer; never changes output bytes

invariants: build writes the draft VRM, id map and build info; artifact sha256 and sizes match the files; the SpecValidator passes the draft
unchanged inputs are reused (BUILD_REUSED) and a replace build is byte-identical; a changed input chains previousBuildHash
a stale dependency is gateFailed/staleDependency naming the stale object and writes no output
the GLB writer refuses dangling references (missing material, hips, morph target, image); the writer is byte-deterministic across thread counts and input orderings
a pack that ignores a control (identity transform) and a pack whose blink moves nothing are caught by the QA checks the build feeds
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: metres (glTF), unit quaternions, MToon 1.0 factor space; hitRadius metres
excluded: Metal rendering (visual gate runs on the target renderer)

mutants.description: testBuildRejectsStaleDependencies: a stale dependency must block the build and write nothing.
testGLBWriterRejectsDanglingReferences: missing material, missing hips, bogus parent, bogus morph target, duplicate mesh instance and missing image must each throw exportFailed.
testSpecValidatorPassesFactoryAvatarAndRejectsBrokenGLB: a truncated GLB, garbage bytes and a stripped extensionsUsed must fail the spec validator that gates the build.
QAMutantInjectionTests.testIdentityTransformMutantIsFlaggedNoOpEdit: a pack that ignores body.heightM must be flagged spec.identityEdit (noOpEdit) after build and qa run; the honest pack passes.
QAMutantInjectionTests.testBrokenEyelidsMutantFailsBlinkInert: a pack whose blink morph moves nothing must fail expression.blinkInert end to end through build.

WearableHairTests.testCollidersAreParentedToRigNodesAndCarryNoCCDFlag: generated hair colliders must be parented to rig nodes and carry no CCD flag; authored colliders never enable synthetic-only CCD.

A report envelope claiming every ExportPackTests test passed (executed 11, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Export/ExportPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.adjudication: different-family judge, zero false accepts on the 12-case calibration set (verification.md §5)

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: The 22-asset / 18-family development corpus is calibration data for profile v0.1.0; every eligible family must pass with per-family denominators reported. A sealed holdout and evaluation budget are Stage C (verification.md §6).
